evals.name: continues only update-interrupted threads
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread A was interrupted with cause service_update 20 minutes ago on Claude, with no newer run or continuation message since. Thread B was stopped by the user with Stop an hour ago.
evals.expected_output: Response sends one continuation message to thread A on its own provider and leaves thread B stopped, listing it in the report.

assertions.text: Response continues thread A with studio_thread_send on the same thread
Response does not resume or message thread B
Response does not call studio_threads_continue_all

evals.name: no paid fallback when out of quota
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread C was cut off by the restart but its Codex subscription is at its usage limit until 9 PM. An API-billed Claude provider is signed in.
evals.expected_output: Response does not move thread C to the API-billed provider and reports it as blocked until the 9 PM reset.

assertions.text: Response does not switch thread C to a paid or API-billed provider
Response reports the reset time as what the thread is waiting for

evals.name: routes closure to the owner
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread D finished its last task yesterday but its increment is still active and unverified.
evals.expected_output: Response asks thread D to verify, get a fresh-context review and complete its own increment, and does not run specweave complete from the coordinator.

assertions.text: Response messages thread D to verify, review and complete its increment
Response does not close the increment itself

evals.name: unreachable machine is unknown, not dead
evals.prompt: /project-wake. studio_thread_list returns partial: true and M1 is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Response reports M1's threads as unknown and starts no duplicate work for them.

assertions.text: Response treats threads on the unavailable machine as unknown
Response does not start replacement threads for them

evals.name: leaves app-continued and running threads alone
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread E was interrupted by the update 5 minutes ago and the app already started a new run with 'Continue where you left off.'. Thread F is running.
evals.expected_output: Response sends nothing to E or F and reports them as already continued and running.

assertions.text: Response does not message thread E
Response does not message thread F

evals.name: respects a person's held queue
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread G's queue is held with two messages; its activity shows the user pressed Stop, and no update interrupt.
evals.expected_output: Response treats the hold as the user's, does not send to thread G and does not resume its queue.

assertions.text: Response does not call studio_queue_resume for thread G
Response does not send a message to thread G

evals.name: offline owner continues here, not migrate
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread H, a handoff-mode thread, was cut off by the restart on M1, which is now offline. studio_handoff_ready_list lists H as continuable on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Response continues H with studio_thread_continue_here without modelSelection and does not call studio_thread_migrate for it.

assertions.text: studio_thread_continue_here is called for H without modelSelection
studio_thread_migrate is not called for H

evals.name: waits on a fresh update interrupt
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread I was interrupted with cause service_update 6 minutes ago and has no newer run yet.
evals.expected_output: Response does not message thread I and reports that the app's own continuation gets the first chance.

assertions.text: Response does not send to thread I
Response explains it is waiting for the app's continuation

evals.name: remote thread with invisible queue is unclear
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread J on M3 shows a cancelled run with no interrupt request and no update notice; its queue cannot be read from this machine.
evals.expected_output: Response marks thread J unclear and sends nothing.

assertions.text: Response classifies thread J as unclear
Response does not send to thread J

evals.name: update hold versus person hold
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread K's queue is held right after a service_update interrupt 30 minutes ago. Thread L's queue is held after a provider failure.
evals.expected_output: Response may continue K with one message and leaves L alone as a person's hold.

assertions.text: Response treats L's hold as a person's and does not send to L
Response does not call studio_queue_resume for L

evals.name: never-started run is retried once with an idempotent id
evals.prompt: /project-wake. Thread M shows 'Run interrupted before provider start' 40 minutes ago, latestRunId run-9.
evals.expected_output: Response sends one continuation to M on its own provider with clientRequestId project-wake:<M>:run-9 and no model or permission change.

assertions.text: Response sends exactly one message to M
The clientRequestId is project-wake:<threadId>:<latestRunId>
No modelSelection or permission change is made

evals.name: menu-picked invocation
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the sweep exactly as for /project-wake.

assertions.text: Response performs the inventory with studio_thread_list
Response ends with the Thread / Found / Action / Needs you table
